prompt: Slow cinematic dolly-in toward a Bambu Lab style 3D printer mid-print in an intimate hobby workshop. Camera glides forward at walking pace on a smooth gimbal, completely steady, no shake, no zoom, no rotation, no panning. Print head moves slowly across the build plate, depositing a thin layer of plastic. Multi-material AMS unit visible to the side with colorful filament spools rotating gently. Warm tungsten work-lamp casts soft pools of golden light onto wooden desk surface, scattered tools and small finished prints catching highlights. Anamorphic 2.39:1 widescreen aesthetic, shallow depth of field with creamy bokeh on the background, Roger Deakins atmospheric lighting with deep shadows and warm amber highlights. Subtle ambient motion only: filament feeds slowly, print head glides smoothly, dust particles drift in light beams. Photorealistic, 35mm anamorphic lens, film grain. NO people, NO hands in frame, NO readable text on screens, NO zoom artifacts.
